text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(Lately, through their training, more and 
more Umamusume are showing signs of 
growth.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(However, I have no intention of letting 
them catch up. Should I increase my daily 
workload to further enhance my physical 
capabilities?)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
—Thinking that, I tried adding weights to 
my wrists, ankles, and torso.
choice_data_list:
I see... You're trembling all over, are 
you alright?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
It seems I put too much of a load on it, 
beyond what I anticipated. ...It'd be best 
to take some of it off.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
*Clatter, THUD!* —The weights were taken 
off with a loud thud. Though it didn't 
show on her face, she seemed utterly 
exhausted.
